events.name: TBD
events.description: PQ defect detected — {DefectType}, Severity: {Severity}

events.name: PQ_TS_DEFECT_RESOLVED
events.description: Issued when PQ RCA validation of a corrective action returns PASS.
events.trigger: PQ RCA returns Validation = PASS after corrective action; PQ TS marks defect resolved and notifies Orchestrator normal operation can resume.

events.name: PQ_TS_DEFECT_ESCALATED
events.description: Issued when PQ RCA validation of a corrective action returns FAIL and PQ TS escalates to next corrective action in troubleshooting sequence.
events.trigger: PQ RCA returns Validation = FAIL, escalation depth < PqTsMaxEscalationDepth.

events.name: PQ_TS_DEFECT_UNRESOLVED
events.description: Issued when max escalation depth reached and defect persists.
events.suspectedCause: Defect not resolved after PqTsMaxEscalationDepth (default 3) escalations.
events.whatToDo: Flag defect for operator intervention; request press stop via Orchestrator if defect severity is Critical.
events.trigger: Escalation depth reaches PqTsMaxEscalationDepth and PQ RCA validation still FAIL.

events.name: UNKNOWN_STATE
events.description: Returned when an invalid/unrecognized state ID is supplied as input
events.trigger: Invalid state input to a State KB query (e.g., computePath)

events.name: TARGET_UNREACHABLE
events.description: Returned when no valid path exists from current state to target state
events.trigger: computePath finds no reachable path between current and target state

events.name: UI_PROCESS_STEP_COMPLETED
events.trigger: Step successfully executed

events.name: UI_PROCESS_STEP_FAILED
events.trigger: Step execution failed

events.name: UI_PROCESS_AVAILABILITY_BLOCKED
events.trigger: Button click failed due to availability

events.name: UI_PROCESS_CONTENT_MAP_MISMATCH
events.trigger: Expected UI element not found

events.name: UI_PROCESS_WINDOW_OPEN_TIMEOUT
events.trigger: Window open exceeded timeout

events.name: UI_PROCESS_BUZZER_REQUIRED
events.trigger: Button requires buzzer activation

events.name: AMR_CLAIM_REQUESTED
events.description: AMR sends claim_request to RMS; RMS Gateway forwards to AE as claim-request indication. AE self-approves via CONTAINER STEP (CLAIM_APPROVAL) without involving Press Orchestrator/Press machine as approval decision-maker (though CLAIM_APPROVAL step itself is executed via Press Orchestrator broadcast).
events.trigger: AMR sends claim_request to RMS

events.name: AMR_CLAIM_RESPONSE
events.description: Response to claim request, contains IsClaimed and ReasonCode.
events.trigger: After CLAIM_APPROVAL container step completes, IsClaimed=true

events.name: AMR_CLAIM_TIMEOUT
events.description: Failure event when TimeoutThresholdSec elapses since claim request without a robot response.
events.stateBehavior: None - not safety-critical, no operator call
events.whatToDo: Mark relevant LOAD or UNLOAD task as failed with claim-timeout reason; no delegation to Press Orchestrator
events.trigger: TimeoutThresholdSec elapses from ClaimRequestedTimestampUTC without AMR response

events.name: CLAIM_FAILURE_CALL_OPERATOR
events.description: Critical timeout after claim approved: AMR may still be physically inside press zone when timeout occurs.
events.stateBehavior: Block further AMR task dispatch for affected machine/device until resolved
events.whatToDo: Do NOT release claim or resume press operations automatically; operator must physically verify AMR position and confirm safe state; claim release/task reset only after explicit operator acknowledgment
events.trigger: TimeoutThresholdSec elapses after AMR_CLAIM_RESPONSE(IsClaimed=true) with no task completion report received

events.name: NOT_SUPPORTED_DRAWER_TYPE
events.description: Logged for traceability when incoming step has DrawerType != PILE; AE is out of scope and does not answer the step.
events.trigger: Incoming Substrate KB step with DrawerType != PILE (applies to order, load, resupply, claim-related paths)

events.name: PHYS_SUBSTRATE_ORDER
events.description: First step of two-step substrate replenishment flow; instructs AMR fleet to move substrate pallet from warehouse to feeder inbound staging before loading. Non-blocking for press production.
events.trigger: Received from Press Orchestrator

events.name: ORDER_COMPLETED
events.description: RMS confirms ORDER mission complete; sets LOAD precondition as met. AE does not wait for separate RMS_FEEDER_INBOUND_STAGING_STATUS confirmation. Does not imply LOAD will start automatically.
events.trigger: RMS completes ORDER mission

events.name: RMS_FEEDER_INBOUND_STAGING_STATUS
events.description: Informational status update on feeder inbound staging, non-blocking; emitted on ORDER_COMPLETED.

events.name: PHYS_SUBSTRATE_LOAD
events.description: Load step; precondition is substrate present in feeder inbound staging for target machine/device. Standalone variant used when feeder confirmed empty (no UNLOAD move, single CLAIM cycle).
events.trigger: Issued by Press Orchestrator after ORDER_COMPLETED

events.name: VERIFY_STAGING_STATUS
events.description: Emitted to Press Orchestrator to confirm correct substrate present in feeder inbound staging before LOAD execution.
events.stateBehavior: If invalid status returned, do not proceed with LOAD; mark step blocked/failed with staging reason

events.name: PHYS_RESUPPLY_SUBSTRATE
events.description: Emitted to initiate resupply mission if replacement flow required.

events.name: PHYS_SUBSTRATE_UNLOAD
events.description: Standalone unload step (later phase). AE emits PHYS_UNLOAD_SUBSTRATE to RMS Gateway; RMS dispatches standalone UNLOAD-only mission. Single CLAIM cycle (#1 only) before UNLOAD move.

events.name: AMR_CLAIM_COMPLETED
events.description: Emitted per CLAIM cycle completion. On this event AE emits ENABLE_FEEDER_OPERATIONS and RESET_FEEDER_SAFETY_CURTAIN. After 2nd occurrence (post-LOAD, CLAIM #2), AE inserts ENABLE_FEEDER_OPERATIONS then VERIFY_FEEDER_STATE steps.

events.name: TASK_SUCCEEDED
events.description: Reported to Press Orchestrator as completion of UNLOAD or LOAD task.

events.name: INSERT_CONTAINER_STEP(CLAIM_APPROVAL)
events.description: Issued to Press Orchestrator upon AMR_CLAIM_REQUESTED. Press Orchestrator broadcasts CLAIM_APPROVAL step to all registered step handlers; only AE expected to respond. Consists of 3 sequential sub-steps: VERIFY_FEEDER_STATE, DISABLE_FEEDER_OPERATIONS, APPROVE_CLAIM.

events.name: VERIFY_FEEDER_STATE
events.description: Sub-step 1 of CLAIM_APPROVAL: validate feeder readiness, confirm feeder in correct position before AMR entry (e.g. lower elevator, wait for positive elevator-down report). Also used post-operation to confirm feeder state after UNLOAD/LOAD complete (includes safety curtain reset).

events.name: DISABLE_FEEDER_OPERATIONS
events.description: Sub-step 2 of CLAIM_APPROVAL: locks FEEDER operations before claim approval to prevent concurrent feeder manipulations. Locked operations: substrate prepare, substrate load, substrate replace, manual feeder intervention actions. Executed on each CLAIM approval (#1 and #2 independently).

events.name: APPROVE_CLAIM
events.description: Sub-step 3 of CLAIM_APPROVAL: records claim approval and prepares AMR_CLAIM_RESPONSE(IsClaimed=true) as final sub-step in same container execution context.

events.name: ENABLE_FEEDER_OPERATIONS
events.description: Re-enables FEEDER operations; sent to Press Orchestrator on AMR_CLAIM_COMPLETED (each cycle), and inserted as sequential step after 2nd AMR_CLAIM_COMPLETED.

events.name: RESET_FEEDER_SAFETY_CURTAIN
events.description: Resets feeder safety curtain; performed as part of VERIFY_FEEDER_STATE post-operation step, and emitted with ENABLE_FEEDER_OPERATIONS on CLAIM completion.

events.name: PRESS_JOB_SUBSTRATE_REQUIRED
events.description: Published step indicating a job requires substrate verification.
events.trigger: Job published with substrate requirement
events.stateBehavior: Component adds a verification step (Verify_Substrate) into the Orchestrator Agenda

events.name: VERIFY_SUBSTRATE
events.description: Verification step inserted into Orchestrator Agenda for a job; added only to user jobs, not special jobs (Phase 1). Verification assessment status updated based on registered data triggers.
events.trigger: PRESS_JOB_SUBSTRATE_REQUIRED published step

events.name: DRAWER_STATE_REQUIRED
events.description: Step entered into agenda based on outcome of substrate verification state machine flow chart.
events.trigger: Substrate Verification Logic state machine outcome

events.name: Assign_Substrate
events.description: Step entered into agenda based on outcome of substrate verification state machine flow chart; mapped to concrete executable steps via step mapper KB.
events.trigger: Substrate Verification Logic state machine outcome

events.name: JOB_PRINT_AVAILABILITY_REQUIRED
events.description: Published to indicate a job availability check is required for a JobID in the print queue.
events.trigger: Raised for a JobID in print Q needing availability evaluation.
events.whatToDo: Component shall issue a VERIFY_JOB_AVAILABILITY container step to the orchestrator agenda.

events.name: AvailabilityID_Not_Found
events.description: Sent when an availability code/mapping is unknown or unmapped, or mapping missing for a known code format.
events.trigger: Unknown/unmapped availability code, or mapping missing for known code format.
events.whatToDo: Inject CALL_OPERATOR fallback step (CALL_OPERATOR allowed only in this case).

parameters.name: maxRetries
parameters.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for a step's retry policy, executed by orchestrator engine if step execution results in FAILED

parameters.name: retryIntervalMs
parameters.description: Delay between retry attempts, part of step's retry policy

parameters.name: timeoutMs
parameters.description: Execution timeout for a step (future execution field)

parameters.name: AUTOX_PQ_RCA_FEATURE_FLAG
parameters.description: PQ RCA feature enable/disable configuration flag (Jira config issue to be created)

parameters.name: PQ_RCA_SENSITIVITY_LEVEL
parameters.description: Sensitivity level override / global sensitivity level for defect detection. Possible values: Low / Standard / High / Custom

parameters.name: PqRcaMaxLatencyMs
parameters.description: Maximum latency from sensor acquisition to defect report. Target < 1 sheet cycle

parameters.name: PqRcaValidationSheets
parameters.description: Number of sheets to monitor during validation mode

parameters.name: PqRcaPersistenceThreshold
parameters.description: Number of consecutive sheets with same defect before escalating severity

parameters.name: PqRcaEnhancedProofSensitivity
parameters.description: Sensitivity multiplier for enhanced proof mode, applied on top of standard thresholds

parameters.name: PqTsMaxDiagnosticIterations
parameters.description: Max diagnostic iterations (isolate-step -> PQ RCA re-analyze cycle) before escalating when root cause unknown.

parameters.name: PqTsValidationSheets
parameters.description: Number of sheets to monitor during post-corrective validation mode.

parameters.name: PqTsMaxEscalationDepth
parameters.description: Max escalation depth for corrective action sequence per defect type/root cause before flagging PQ_TS_DEFECT_UNRESOLVED.

parameters.name: PipPartNumber
parameters.defaultValue: Phase1: 2F313A | Q4428A. Phase2 (keyed by OCB flags - Wide/Narrow, Web/Sheet fed): Wide+Web=2F313A|Q4422A; Wide+SheetFed=2F313A|Q4428A; Narrow+Web=2F503A|Q4431A; Narrow+SheetFed=2F503A|Q4430A
parameters.description: Pip part number, list type, selected per press configuration via OCB flags (width narrow/wide, web/sheet-fed via WebPaperHandlingSupport flag). Golden PIPs applicable to both web and sheet-fed presses.

parameters.name: Window open response time
parameters.description: Simulated press UI latency for window open response, range 100-5000 ms

parameters.name: Button click response time
parameters.description: Simulated click latency for button click response, range 50-2000 ms

parameters.name: Availability failure rate
parameters.description: Simulated rate of availability issues occurring during button click, range 0-100%

parameters.name: WindowOpenTimeout
parameters.description: Max time to wait for window open response from Press UI GW

parameters.name: ButtonClickTimeout
parameters.description: Max time to wait for button click response from Press UI GW

parameters.name: PageNavigationDelay
parameters.description: Minimum delay between consecutive page navigation actions

parameters.name: MaxRetryOnAvailability
parameters.description: Max number of retries for a step after availability resolution

parameters.name: ContentMapVersion
parameters.description: Version identifier of the loaded content map

parameters.name: TimeoutThresholdSec
parameters.description: Threshold for AMR claim timeout, measured from ClaimRequestedTimestampUTC (no-response case) or from AMR_CLAIM_RESPONSE(IsClaimed=true) (post-approval completion-timeout case).

parameters.name: ClaimRequestedTimestampUTC
parameters.description: Timestamp of original claim request, used as timeout reference and to match claim_response to claim_request (with MachineID, DeviceID) since no dedicated Claim ID exists.

parameters.name: SubstrateGapQuanity
parameters.description: Calculated gap = (AccumulatedSubstrate + PageRemainingCount(J) - AvailableSubstrate) x SheetsFactor. Used to determine how many sheets are missing (Is Substrate Enough check).

parameters.name: PageRemainingCount
parameters.description: Remaining page count for a given jobID.

parameters.name: AvailableSubstrate
parameters.description: Substrate level read from all online drawers assigned to the required substrateID (or forced drawer).

parameters.name: AccumulatedSubstrate
parameters.description: Value received from press orchestrator, used in substrate gap calculation. Marked Phase 3.

parameters.name: SheetsFactor
parameters.description: Static percentage for ordering buffer, used as multiplier in substrate gap calculation.

parameters.name: MaxTotalPendingQtySubstrate
parameters.description: Cap on sum of quantities across all pending/in-flight ordering steps for a single consumable. If total pending qty >= cap, no new ordering step is created for that consumable regardless of remaining deficit.
